title: Shambhu Nath Mehra v. State of Ajmer

content.caseIdentity: Shambhu Nath Mehra v. State of Ajmer, AIR 1956 SC 404
content.holding: The “especially within knowledge” rule (then IEA 106) does not lift the prosecution’s burden of the offence; it applies to facts which the accused, and not the prosecution, can be expected to know.
content.relevance: Apply to BSA s. 109. Do not use special knowledge to reverse the whole case.
